stuntRules: Same engine as combat stunts: on a successful test with doubles, gain SP = Dragon Die, spend immediately. The same stunt only once per test. The player narrates the stunt.
Roleplaying stunts must fit the interaction as described. Stunts can target PCs.
The GM may rule any non-combat test can't generate SP, or that combat SP can't be spent on these stunts. The GM never has to invent new facts to satisfy a stunt.
'Until the time or venue changes' = until the focus of play jumps ahead in time significantly or moves elsewhere (about one encounter).

explorationStunts.name: Advantageous Positioning
explorationStunts.effect: Make the discovery from a position of your choice up to 2 yd from where it would normally happen.

explorationStunts.name: Efficient Search
explorationStunts.effect: Use half the resources normally consumed.

explorationStunts.name: That Makes Me Wonder
explorationStunts.effect: Immediate extra Perception test (different focus, no extra time/resources; doubles give no SP).

explorationStunts.name: The Object of Your Attention
explorationStunts.effect: +1 to further tests on that object until time/venue changes.

explorationStunts.name: The Upper Hand
explorationStunts.effect: If the discovery leads to combat within a moment or two, +3 initiative.

explorationStunts.name: Resources at Hand
explorationStunts.effect: Treat a focus you lack (same ability as the test) as yours until time/venue changes.

explorationStunts.name: With a Flourish
explorationStunts.effect: +1 on opposed tests vs onlookers until time/venue changes.

roleplayingStunts.name: Bon Mot
roleplayingStunts.effect: Perfect witty remark deepens the effect on all who hear it.

roleplayingStunts.name: And Another Thing
roleplayingStunts.effect: Weave in a second thread; may make an additional test as part of the action.

roleplayingStunts.name: Sway the Crowd
roleplayingStunts.effect: Affect one additional person (repeatable). On opposed tests, can't extend to anyone with higher ability+focus total than the original target.

roleplayingStunts.name: Stunned Silence
roleplayingStunts.effect: Witnesses are dumbfounded for at least a full round.

roleplayingStunts.name: Jest
roleplayingStunts.effect: Nearby must pass TN 11 Willpower (Self-Discipline) or laugh (butt of joke excepted at GM's discretion).

roleplayingStunts.name: Flirt
roleplayingStunts.effect: Opposed Communication (Seduction) vs Willpower (Self-Discipline); win: target enamored (GM/player decides what that means).

roleplayingStunts.name: Tower of Will
roleplayingStunts.effect: +1 on opposed tests where an opponent tries to put you at emotional disadvantage, for the rest of the exchange.

roleplayingStunts.name: Enrage
roleplayingStunts.effect: Single target must attack you or storm away.

text: Characters hold about three goals at a time (at least one or two are the character's goals; others may be the player's goals for the character). Goals may be shared with the party or hidden.
Simple goal: one sentence, active verb, in character voice.

A goal usually carries an implied reward (item, title, lands). XP may be awarded (Easy/Average/Hard; more for long goals; even for failed or abandoned goals if the character grew). Unique abilities should not duplicate talents or class powers. After completing a goal, ask: what's next?

organizations.troopsFormula: (Might + Wealth + Influence) x multiplier for the scope

creation.text: Assign with the GM; Stability about 25-45, Structure 2-6; pick two focuses.

Assign 3, 2, 1, 1, 0 across the five abilities (may lower one by 1 to raise another by 1). Structure 3; Stability = 25 + 2d6 + highest ability; Scope Local; two focuses, one tied to the highest ability.
Roll abilities as for a character (3d6 table, one swap allowed); Structure = 1d6 - 1; Stability = 25 + 2d6 + highest ability; Scope d6: 1-4 Local, 5-6 Regional; two focuses (one for highest ability).

organizations.growthCheck: Once per month (GM may slow), TN 10 test with the organization's highest ability. Success = steady; fail = lose 2d6 Stability, or reduce an ability, Scope or Structure by 1 (abilities not below -2, Structure not below 0, Scope not below Local) unless the PCs address it. Doubles on success: Growth stunts.
organizations.misfortuneNote: The printed table overlaps at 8; check the book.

growthStunts.name: New Assets
growthStunts.effect: +1 to an ability of 5 or less.

growthStunts.name: Greater Assets
growthStunts.effect: +1 to an ability of 6 or more.

plots.text: Opposed test between organizations (relevant focus +2 each). Winner deals 2d6 + ability used to the loser's Stability, reduced by the loser's Structure. If the defender wins, the attacker takes that damage instead. A larger-Scope plotter gets +2 per Scope step but stunts cost +2 SP per step. Doubles: Plot stunts.
plots.note: Costs 1-6 SP; the per-stunt costs and effects (book pp. 147-150) are not transcribed yet.
